description: 兵对兵③：王的活跃性 — 白王活跃位置决定胜负

intro.popup_en: The white king on b4 is closer to the pawn battle than the black king on f5. White moves first; can it turn this activity into a win?
intro.popup: 💡 王的活跃性：白王 b4 比黑王 f5 更靠近兵的战场，主动性更强。白先如何利用这一优势？

outro.popup_en: Draw. Although the white king is more active, the black king returns in time to defend. King activity is necessary but not sufficient to win.
outro.popup: ☰ 结论：和局！ 尽管白王更活跃，但黑王能及时回防，兵的对峙维持平衡。王的活跃性是必要但不充分的取胜条件。

moves.popup_en: 1. Kc5: the white king heads toward the center and threatens the black pawn.
moves.popup: 1.Kc5 — 白王向中心进发，威胁黑兵。

moves.popup_en: 1...Ke6: the black king returns quickly to defend the d5-pawn.
moves.popup: 1...Ke6 — 黑王迅速回防，守住 d5 兵。

moves.popup_en: 2. Kxd5: the white king captures the pawn, but Black can still draw.
2...Kd7: the black king follows closely and is about to take the opposition to stop the white pawn.
moves.popup: 2...Kd7 — 黑王紧追，即将占据对立位拦截白兵。
